
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/swizard/p/19646909" title="发布于 2026-02-27 14:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">逐行解剖：扒开 Lovable Agent 源码，看顶级 AI 是如何“思考”与“动刀”的</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1703/202602/1703-20260227144246986-343938650.png" alt="image"></p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="4">1. 引言：从“盲目输出”到“精准微创”</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">痛点场景</strong>： 大多数人自己写 Prompt 时，AI 就像一个莽撞的实习生：你让他改个按钮颜色，他顺手把整个页面的布局都重写了，甚至还引入了你项目里根本没有的 Vue.js 依赖。不仅改错，还极其浪费 Token 成本。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="6"><strong data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="0">解决方案</strong>： Lovable 的解决之道，是将 AI 从一个“打字机”变成一位**“主治外科医生”**。它的核心策略就是四个字：<strong data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="63">极度克制</strong>。今天我们通过它的原版 Prompt，来看看这把“手术刀”是怎么打造的。</p>
<hr data-path-to-node="7">
<h3 data-path-to-node="8">2. 概念拆解：“主治医师”的行医执照 (The "What" &amp; "Why")</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="9"><strong data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="0">生活化类比</strong>：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="10">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="10,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="10,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">普通代码生成器</strong>就像<strong data-path-to-node="10,0,0" data-index-in-node="9">街边的快印店</strong>：你给文字，它就疯狂打印（生成大量代码覆盖原文件）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="10,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Lovable Agent</strong> 是一位<strong data-path-to-node="10,1,0" data-index-in-node="17">外科主治医师</strong>。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="10,1,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="10,1,1,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">术前会诊 (Discussion Mode)</strong>：绝不轻易动刀，先和你确认哪里痛。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="10,1,1,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">查阅病历 (Context limitation)</strong>：明确知道你用的是什么药（技术栈），不能乱开处方。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="10,1,1,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,1,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">微创手术 (Search-Replace Tool)</strong>：只切开需要缝合的那 1 厘米，绝不把整个肚子剖开（不重写全文件）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-path-to-node="11">
<h3 data-path-to-node="12">3. 动手实战与源码对照 (The "How" &amp; Deep Dive)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="13">让我们直接对照 Lovable <code data-path-to-node="13" data-index-in-node="16">Agent Prompt.txt</code> 的原文，看看它的每一条“军规”到底解决了什么开发痛点。</p>
<h4 data-path-to-node="14">观点一：赋予 AI“物理空间感知”，避免自说自话</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="15">绝大多数 Prompt 只教 AI 写代码，却忘了告诉 AI 它自己“在哪”。</p>
<blockquote data-path-to-node="16">
<p data-path-to-node="16,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,0" data-index-in-node="0">Lovable 源码原文</strong>： <em data-path-to-node="16,0" data-index-in-node="14">"Interface Layout: On the left hand side of the interface, there's a chat window where users chat with you... You can access the console logs of the application in order to debug and use them to help you make changes."</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-path-to-node="17"><strong data-path-to-node="17" data-index-in-node="0">深度解析</strong>： 这是一种非常高级的**上下文锚定（Context Anchoring）**技巧。Lovable 明确告诉大模型：“用户在左边和你说话，右边是预览区，你还可以直接读取控制台日志”。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="18">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="18,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="18,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Why（为什么这么写）</strong>：这让 AI 知道自己是一个嵌在 IDE 里的助手，而不是网页端聊天的 ChatGPT。当它需要排错时，它知道有 <code data-path-to-node="18,0,0" data-index-in-node="68">console logs</code> 存在（可以调用 Tool 去获取），而不是让用户“请把报错信息复制给我”。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-path-to-node="19">观点二：技术栈的“绝对独裁”，根绝幻觉</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="20">代码越写越乱，通常是因为 AI “自作多情”地引入了不兼容的库。</p>
<blockquote data-path-to-node="21">
<p data-path-to-node="21,0"><strong data-path-to-node="21,0" data-index-in-node="0">Lovable 源码原文</strong>： <em data-path-to-node="21,0" data-index-in-node="14">"Technology Stack: Lovable projects are built on top of React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript. Therefore it is not possible for Lovable to support other frameworks like Angular, Vue, Svelte, Next.js, native mobile apps, etc. Backend Limitations: Lovable also cannot run backend code di<span class="citation-504">rectly."</span></em></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-path-to-node="22"><strong data-path-to-node="22" data-index-in-node="0"><span class="citation-503">深度解析</span></strong><span class="citation-503 citation-end-503">：</span> <span class="citation-502">注意原词的强烈语气：“</span><strong data-path-to-node="22" data-index-in-node="17"><span class="citation-502">not possible</span></strong><span class="citation-502">”、“</span><strong data-path-to-node="22" data-index-in-node="32"><span class="citation-502">cannot</span></strong><span class="citation-502 citation-end-502">”。</span></p>
<ul data-path-to-node="23">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="23,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="23,0,0" data-index-in-node="0"><span class="citation-501">Why</span></strong><span class="citation-501">：这是对模型知识库的</span><strong data-path-to-node="23,0,0" data-index-in-node="13"><span class="citation-501">降维封锁</span></strong><span class="citation-501 citation-end-501">。大模型懂 Angular 和 Vue，但这段话直接将其“阉割”到只剩 React + Vite 体系。即使用户强烈要求写个 Vue 组件，AI 也会根据这条铁律断然拒绝，从而保证了生成的代码能在当前容器中 100% 跑通。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-path-to-node="24"><span class="citation-500 citation-end-500">观点三：防御性工作流，谋定而后动 (ReAct 架构核心)</span></h4>
<p data-path-to-node="25"><span class="citation-499 citation-end-499">这是决定 Agent 质量的最核心指令，也就是我在上一篇提到的“刹车机制”。</span></p>
<blockquote data-path-to-node="26">
<p data-path-to-node="26,0"><strong data-path-to-node="26,0" data-index-in-node="0"><span class="citation-498 citation-end-498">Lovable 源码</span>原文</strong>： <em data-path-to-node="26,0" data-index-in-node="14">"DEFAULT TO DISCUSSION MODE: Assume the user wants to discuss and plan rather than implement code... Define EXACTLY what will change and what will remain untouched - Plan a minimal but CORRECT approach needed to fulfill the request."</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-path-to-node="27"><strong data-path-to-node="27" data-index-in-node="0">深度解析</strong>：</p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="28">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="28,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="28,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">"Assume the user wants to discuss"</strong>：逆向思维。默认用户只是来聊天的，除非遇到明确的动作词（"implement", "code"）。这防止了 AI 过度活跃（Over-eager generation）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="28,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="28,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">"Define EXACTLY what will change and what will remain untouched"</strong>：这是大师级的约束。写代码最难的不是写新功能，而是<strong data-path-to-node="28,1,0" data-index-in-node="89">不破坏老功能</strong>（regression）。强制 AI 在动手前写下“我不碰什么”，能极大降低大模型的注意力偏移（Attention drift）。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-path-to-node="29">观点四：极致的 Tool 效率与“微创手术”</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="30">当 AI 决定动手时，怎么动？Lovable 对工具的调用要求极其严苛。</p>
<blockquote data-path-to-node="31">
<p data-path-to-node="31,0"><strong data-path-to-node="31,0" data-index-in-node="0">Lovable 源码原文</strong>： <em data-path-to-node="31,0" data-index-in-node="14">"MAXIMIZE EFFICIENCY... always invoke all relevant tools simultaneously. Never make sequential tool calls when they can be combined."</em> <em data-path-to-node="31,0" data-index-in-node="148">"IMPLEMENTATION (when relevant): - Prefer using the search-replace tool rather than the write tool - Create small, focused components instead of large files"</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-path-to-node="32"><strong data-path-to-node="32" data-index-in-node="0">深度解析</strong>：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="33">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="33,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="33,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">并发调用（Simultaneously）</strong>：在真实调用的 <code data-path-to-node="33,0,0" data-index-in-node="28">Tools.json</code> 中，读取多个文件如果是一个接一个调用（顺序调用），每次都要等大模型响应，速度极慢且极其消耗上下文。Lovable 强制 AI 采用批量操作。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="33,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="33,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">微创手术（Prefer search-replace tool）</strong>：这是整个工具链设计的灵魂！很多低级 Agent 修改代码时，使用的是 <code data-path-to-node="33,1,0" data-index-in-node="68">write_file</code>（全量覆盖），这非常容易丢失原有逻辑。Lovable 明确指导 AI 优先使用 <code data-path-to-node="33,1,0" data-index-in-node="118">search-replace</code>（搜索并替换局部代码），这要求 AI 必须精准定位代码块，实现了极低成本的精准修改。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-path-to-node="34">
<h3 data-path-to-node="35">4. 总结：系统提示词的本质是“工程管理”</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="36">读完源码你会发现，Lovable 的 System Prompt 根本不是在教 AI “怎么写好代码”，而是在做<strong data-path-to-node="36" data-index-in-node="56">项目工程管理</strong>：</p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="37">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,0,0">规范沟通边界（讨论优先）；</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,1,0">约束技术选型（锁定 React）；</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,2,0">控制交付质量（规划先行，微创修改）。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-path-to-node="38">把大模型当成一个<strong data-path-to-node="38" data-index-in-node="8">智商很高但没有常识的顶尖应届生</strong>，System Prompt 就是你给他的《入职第一天必须遵守的 10 条死命令》。</p>

</div>
